## Hi, I'm Spencer!

I came to data science after finding an intro class at Willamette University. 
Now I'm passionate about finding new ways to make sense of information and 
sharing those insights with others.

At Willamette, my education has been highly interdisciplinary and my data 
science focus has been data engineering and visualization. My [capstone](capstone.qmd) 
is where that comes together.

### Beyond the terminal

- 🌲 I arrange music and enjoy music production & mixing.

- 🎯 Looking for a permanent data role on the West coast.
